[pagebreak]

Maria Eden has no MCM menu. If you absolutely must configure anything, you will have to edit the configuration files. The following files can be found under Data/SKSE/Plugins/StorageUtilData MariaHotkeys.json This contains the most important hotkeys. Their names are self-explanatory. You can find the corresponding codes at https://www.creationkit.com/index.php?title=Input_Script#DXScanCodes There are in-game menus for all other configuration files. [pagebreak] Outfits All Maria mods rely heavily on outfits. Maria Eden includes an outfit manager. Outfits are divided into several fixed categories. Outfits can be created, copied, modified, and deleted through the outfit manager. SlaveTats are treated as part of an outfit. Once you have opened the outfit manager, adjust your outfit and then press Escape to close the outfit manager, or Return to save the current outfit. [pagebreak] Poses Many Maria mods use poses. A large set of predefined poses is available. Some of them require ZAP 8. You can add your own poses or assign poses to a hotkey. Details can be found in Data/SKSE/Plugins/StorageUtilData int MariaIdleIDs.txt. Maria mods use these IDs to identify the player's current pose—for example, ID 1 is considered the "Kneeling" pose. If you assign more than one animation to an ID, one will be selected at random each time. [pagebreak] Locations Maria Eden quests are often based on locations. Many locations are predefined, but you can also define your own. [pagebreak] NPC Management Maria Eden provides an extensive set of tools for modifying NPCs during a running game. If you want to assign an outfit to an NPC permanently, add that NPC to the Managed NPCs group. These assignments persist even when you start a new game, so the outfits will remain assigned.
